name: HDFC Liquid Fund — Direct Plan, Growth

rules.notes: PLACEHOLDER — a liquid scheme levies its load only on units redeemed within the first week, which is the holding-period predicate AC-6 names. Stated as a predicate rather than as bands because the load does not taper here; the flexi-cap profile is the graded form. #holdingDays is published per lot by the engine, so the predicate is answered once per lot rather than once per redemption.
